publish-script-desc: Path to deployment script that publishes your built website to server. Can be absolute path or relative to VitePress project directory.
vitepress-folder-path-desc: Path to your VitePress project root (folder containing package.json). The plugin will execute build and preview commands in this directory.
publish-content-desc: Choose which folders or files from your Obsidian vault to sync to VitePress. Supports multiple selections - only selected content will be copied on startup. Leave empty to copy nothing on startup (but modified files will still sync in development mode).
vitepress-srcDir-path-desc: Directory where VitePress reads Markdown files. Your Obsidian content will be synced here, typically 'docs' or 'src' folder under project root.
need-absolute-path: Please enter the complete absolute path (e.g., /Users/username/projects/vitepress)
clean-src-dir: Clear srcDir directory before executing the command
clean-src-dir-desc: Clear target directory before each sync. Recommended to avoid leftover files, but will delete all existing content in the target directory.
vitepress-fixed-dir-desc: Path to directory outside your Obsidian vault. All files in this directory will be automatically copied to VitePress publish directory on each sync, merging with your Obsidian content.
filter-doc-desc: Use regex to exclude files you don't want to sync. Example: 'tmp|draft' will ignore files containing tmp or draft. Leave empty to sync all files.
filter-example: Example: 'private|draft' excludes files containing these words
plugin-action-tip: According to the current configuration, the following operations will be performed when previewing or compiling
plugin-action-tip-move-to-src-dir: Move files from the configured fixed directory to the srcDir directory
plugin-action-tip-filter-by-regex: Filter files that match the regular expression ({{regex}}) in the file name
plugin-action-tip-public-move-to-src-dir: Move the published content to the srcDir directory
guide-to-setting: The {{name}} is not set, click here to set
file-not-existed-check: {{name}} does not exist, please check the settings
auto-sync-md-desc: Automatically watch for Obsidian file changes and sync to VitePress in development mode. Disable this to require manual refresh to see changes.
parser-dataview-desc: Convert Dataview code blocks to Dataview processing results. Requires Dataview plugin to be installed.
parser-dataviewjsdesc: Experimental feature: Convert DataviewJS code blocks to DataviewJS processing results. Requires Dataview plugin to be installed. Note: DOM operations (like dv.span, dv.paragraph) are not supported, only data queries.
command-configuration-desc: Customize build commands, defaults to VitePress, but can be replaced with Hugo, Hexo and other static site generators. Keep default settings if you're not familiar with command line.
dev-command-desc: Command to start local preview server. Default: npm run docs:dev
build-command-desc: Command to generate static website files for server deployment. Default: npm run docs:build
preview-command-desc: Command to preview built website before publishing. Default: npm run docs:preview
command-support-desc:
Supports other static site generators. Provide full executable path with arguments.
Examples:
• Hugo: /opt/homebrew/bin/hugo serve
• Hexo: npx hexo server
• Docusaurus: npm start
